brief: Remove white space from both ends
description: Remove white space and line terminators as ECMAScript counts them (tab, vertical tab, form feed, space, no-break space, U+FEFF, every Unicode space separator, LF, CR, U+2028 and U+2029) from the beginning and end of the anyURI value, as ECMAScript s.trim() does. White space inside the value is kept; normalize_space also collapses it. The result is a string.

returns.description: The value without leading and trailing white space, as a string.
